stage: fixed auxiliary readout before calculating its N100/N400 comparison and before N900 reveal; the width and unstandardized peaks were already inspected
primary: rank-step signed-profile standardized central moments mu_r/sigma^r for r=3,4,5,6
rank_step_definition: S(p)=f_j for j/N<=p<(j+1)/N; unit signed-area normalization; centered at its own mean; sigma=sqrt(central second moment)
canonical_auxiliary: same four standardized central moments, with exact Bernstein integration, to expose finite-N smoothing dependence
three ordinal interior extrema: first peak, intervening valley, second peak
shape_null: All corresponding standardized coordinates agree between independent areas, allowing arbitrary center, positive width, and nonzero total amplitude at each area
uncertainty: same-batch leave-one-out jointly across moments and extrema within each source; independent source covariance blocks across areas
gates: Do not select moment orders or windows after seeing significance; if a variance is nonpositive or the ordered critical pattern is not three, report that boundary rather than changing normalization or choosing other peaks
N900_role: auxiliary mechanism readout only; does not alter the already named rank-variance primary predictions
